text:
Marathon Petroleum rose 2.5% today, rebounding from a steep three-day drop that had wiped out nearly 5% of its value. The bounce comes as refining profits are surging globally—competing refiners like Chevron and Exxon hit all-time highs today on the back of geopolitical disruptions in Ukraine and Iran that have spiked diesel prices worldwide. With refineries running at 92.8% capacity and diesel inventories relatively tight at 102.8 million barrels, MPC stands to benefit from the tight supply-demand balance driving margins higher.

The stock's wild swings over the past week reflect investor uncertainty ahead of Big Oil earnings season, compounded by yesterday's news that MPC changed leadership and announced a company update. While global crude is flowing again through the Strait of Hormuz despite Iranian attacks, the refining sector is capturing significant upside from the regional tensions—at least in the near term.
